name: JGC Group
description: Japanese plant EPC with LNG dominating its recent order backlog (JGC Report 2024: roughly 88 percent LNG-related), including participation in Malaysia's PFLNG Satu, the world's first floating LNG facility, and the PNG LNG onshore EPC with Chiyoda. In alliance with Toyo Engineering since 2022 for fuel-ammonia production plants and import terminals in Japan ahead of the 2024-2027 ammonia construction wave.
